entries.240542764ef7fc24: This reportable segment conducts power generation and electricity sales and integrated energy supply businesses on an integrated basis. It is the largest of the three reportable segments, with revenue from external customers of ¥1,201,930 million for the fiscal year ended March 2026. Revenue decreased from the previous year, due to a decrease in the fuel cost adjustment amount resulting from lower fuel prices, although retail electricity sales volume increased. Power generation comes from hydro, thermal, nuclear, new energy and other sources, and sales are divided between retail sales of lighting and power and sales to other companies. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, Shimane Nuclear Power Plant Unit 2 came into operation, and nuclear power generation volume significantly exceeded the previous year.
